pseudocode: else: real_kg = vol_kg = 0                                                    # '' counts as 0 in MAXA
taxable_kg   = max(colli_kg or 0, real_kg, vol_kg)                            # K10 = MAXA(K3:K4:K5) i.e. K3:K5
is_long      = width_cm[1] > 220 or length_cm[1] > 220      # ROW 8 ONLY       # J8
K12 'Costo Consegna / Distribuzione' = 1.5*distribution if is_long else (blank if taxable_kg < 3 else distribution)
K14 'Costo spedizione / Nolo'        = blank if is_long else (total if triangulation == 'NO' else blank)
K16 'Costo Triangolazione'           = total + K12 if triangulation == 'SI' else blank   # #VALUE! when K12 is blank
K18 'Costo totale merce Lungha '     = long_total if is_long else blank
CALCOLI!B19 'NORD' = total + 1.80   # hub handling per pallet

bugs_and_inconsistencies: Long goods are detected on row 8 only (J8, B16): a long pallet on rows 9-12 is priced as normal (R8).
The 1100 kg limit is checked on row 8 only (B20) (R9); limits are warnings and never block the cost (R11).
CALCOLI!F17:F19 (1100, 220, 240) are documentation only: the formulas hard-code the same numbers.
'*Minimo tassabile 3 kg' (J19) is not applied: K14 is computed on the real kg (R6, R13); K12 is merely blanked under 3 kg.
'*Fino 29,90 kg ... viene tassato come collo' (J20) is not implemented: there is no parcel tariff or branch.
Hub handling (0.15 colli / 1.80 bancale) is added only in CALCOLI!B19, which nothing displays; CALCOLI!A17 always selects the pallet value.
The HUB name (NORD/SUD) is defined but unused; no destination input exists, so the cost is identical for every destination.
The 'Qta' column is a row counter, not a quantity; at most 5 rows.
K14 is labelled 'Costo spedizione / Nolo' but contains line + distribution (H7); K12 shows the distribution again: adding K12 and K14 double-counts.
Triangulation K16 = H7 + K12: #VALUE! under 3 kg (R7); with long goods it mixes the normal total with the long distribution and is shown next to K18 (R10).
With long goods J14 still shows 'Costo spedizione / Nolo' with an empty K14 (R3).
K3 keeps its value when the goods type changes and still enters MAXA (R12).
B16 says 'fare spediz. Singola' while J21/K8 say +50%: two different instructions for the same case.
C18 and C20 test B17/B19, which are inside merged ranges and always empty, and are themselves hidden by the merges: dead formulas.
Conditional formatting: rule on B10:G11 references #REF!; rule on B9:G9 references $G6 instead of $D$3 (cosmetic).
'Lungha' / 'Merce Lungha' is a typo of 'lunga'; the formulas rely on case-insensitive comparison ('merce lungha', 'MERCE LUNGHA').
No volumetric weight for colli: the user must compute it and type it into K3.
PV ratio 200 here, 300 in the MOSCA customer list, 250 in the new site's example: different contexts, make it a per-list parameter.
Per-pallet maximum 1100 kg here vs 1200 kg for the FP class of the MOSCA list.
